decisions.statement: An error whose loaded build differs from the deployed build came from memory.
An error whose loaded build matches the deployed build is happening now.
An error against an addon with no deployed build is judged unknown.
An addon the game attributed is judged ahead of an addon a signature inferred.
An error attributed to nothing and inferring nothing is judged unknown.
A judgement drawn from an inferred addon is named apart from an attributed addon.

definition: whether an error came from the build now deployed or from one left in memory
